arxiv-2106-14516.title: A Diffeomorphic Aging Model for Adult Human Brain from Cross-Sectional Data
arxiv-2106-14516.creator: Alphin J Thottupattu, Jayanthi Sivaswamy, Venkateswaran P.Krishnan
arxiv-2106-14516.description: Abstract Normative aging trends of the brain can serve as an important reference in the assessment of neurological structural disorders. Such models are typically developed from longitudinal brain image data – follow-up data of the same subject over different time points. In practice, obtaining such longitudinal data is difficult.

arxiv-2203-06045.title: Integer Sets of Large Harmonic Sum which Avoid Long Arithmetic Progressions
arxiv-2203-06045.creator: Alexander Walker August 8, 2026
arxiv-2203-06045.description: Abstract . We give conditions under which certain digit-restricted integer sets avoid k k -term arithmetic progressions. These sets are reasonably efficient to compute and therefore enable large-scale search. We identify a set with no arithmetic progression of four terms and with harmonic sum 4.43975 4.43975 , which improves an earlier “greedy” construction.

arxiv-2302-14734.title: Langlands duality for skein modules of 3-manifolds
arxiv-2302-14734.creator: David Jordan
arxiv-2302-14734.description: Abstract . I introduce new Langlands duality conjectures concerning skein modules of 3-manifolds, which we have made recently with David Ben-Zvi, Sam Gunningham, and Pavel Safronov. I recount some historical motivation and some recent special cases where the conjecture is confirmed.

arxiv-2306-02193.title: LDEB: Label Digitization with Emotion Binarization and Machine Learning for Emotion Recognition in Conversational Dialogues
arxiv-2306-02193.creator: Amitabha Dey, Shan Suthaharan
arxiv-2306-02193.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Amitabha Dey, Shan Suthaharan. Emotion recognition in conversations (ERC) is vital to the advancements of conversational AI and its applications. Therefore, the development of an automated ERC model using the concepts of machine learning (ML) would be beneficial. However, the conversational dialogues present a unique problem where each dialogue depicts nested emotions that entangle the association between the emotional feature descriptors and emotion type (or label).

arxiv-2411-09920.title: Bijectivizing the PT–DT Correspondence
arxiv-2411-09920.creator: Cruz Godar, Benjamin Young
arxiv-2411-09920.description: Abstract Pandharipande–Thomas theory and Donaldson–Thomas theory (PT and DT) are two branches of enumerative geometry in which particular generating functions arise that count plane-partition-like objects. That these generating functions differ only by a factor of MacMahon’s function was proven recursively in [ JWY22 ] using the double dimer model.

arxiv-2509-17187.title: Ambiguous Medical Image Segmentation Using Diffusion Schrödinger Bridge
arxiv-2509-17187.creator: Lalith Bharadwaj Baru* 1, Kamalaker Dadi 1, Tapabrata Chakraborti* 2, Raju S. Bapi 1
arxiv-2509-17187.description: Abstract Accurate segmentation of medical images is challenging due to unclear lesion boundaries and mask variability. We introduce Segmentation Schödinger Bridge (SSB) , the first application of Schödinger Bridge for ambiguous medical image segmentation, modelling joint image-mask dynamics to enhance performance. SSB preserves structural integrity, delineates unclear boundaries without additional guidance, and maintains diversity using a novel loss function.

arxiv-2510-00408.title: Anomalous low-field magnetoresistance in Fe 3 Ga 4 single crystals
arxiv-2510-00408.creator: Michelle E. Jamer, Gregory M. Stephen, Brandon Wilfong, Radhika Barua, Frank M. Abel, Steven P. Bennett, Joseph C. Prestigiacomo, Don Heiman, Dave Graf
arxiv-2510-00408.description: Abstract Fe 3 Ga 4 possesses a helical spin spiral with a complex competition between ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic ground states. This competition generates multiple metamagnetic transitions that are governed by both applied magnetic field and temperature. At intermediate temperatures between T 1 (68 K) and T 2 (360 K), the ferromagnetically aligned spins transition to an antiferromagnetic spin spiral.

arxiv-2511-11120.title: Magnetic flux and its topological effects in Aharonov-Bohm effect
arxiv-2511-11120.creator: Manvendra Somvanshi, D. Jaffino Stargen
arxiv-2511-11120.description: Abstract The Aharonov-Bohm effect is a physical phenomenon in which the quantum state of a charged particle acquires a phase shift that is directly proportional to the magnetic flux, Φ \Phi , due to a (classical) magnetic field, 𝐁 {\mathbf{B}} , which is confined in a spatial region from which the magnetic field cannot escape.

arxiv-2512-19066.title: A Self-Consistent Hubble Expansion in f ⁡ ( T ) f(T) Gravity model: Confrontation with Recent Observations
arxiv-2512-19066.description: Abstract The accelerated expansion of the universe remains one of the most profound puzzles in modern cosmology, often attributed to dark energy within the framework of General Relativity. As an alternative, modified teleparallel gravity theories such as f ⁡ ( T ) f(T) gravity offer a purely geometric mechanism to explain cosmic acceleration.

europmc-pmc4446215.title: Mouse models of diet-induced nonalcoholic steatohepatitis reproduce the heterogeneity of the human disease.
europmc-pmc4446215.creator: Machado MV, Michelotti GA, Xie G, Almeida Pereira T, Boursier J, Bohnic B, Guy CD, Diehl AM.
europmc-pmc4446215.description: Background and aims Non-alcoholic steatohepatitis (NASH), the potentially progressive form of nonalcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD), is the pandemic liver disease of our time. Although there are several animal models of NASH, consensus regarding the optimal model is lacking.

plos-pone-0000598.title: Treatment of Fabry Disease: Outcome of a Comparative Trial with Agalsidase Alfa or Beta at a Dose of 0.2 mg/kg
plos-pone-0000598.creator: Anouk C. Vedder, Gabor E. Linthorst, Gunnar Houge et al.
plos-pone-0000598.description: PLOS ONE research article. Two different enzyme preparations, agalsidase alfa (Replagal TM , Shire) and beta (Fabrazyme TM , Genzyme), are registered for treatment of Fabry disease. We compared the efficacy of and tolerability towards the two agalsidase preparations administered at identical protein dose i

plos-pone-0001254.creator: Katrina Gwinn, Roderick A. Corriveau, Hiroshi Mitsumoto et al.
plos-pone-0001254.description: PLOS ONE research article. Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is the most common form of motor neuron disease (MND). It is currently incurable and treatment is largely limited to supportive care. Family history is associated with an increased risk of ALS, and many Mendelian causes have been discovered. Ho

pmc-10600268.title: A Case of Colon Cancer with Extramural Tumor Deposits in the Main Lymph Node Area: A Case Report
pmc-10600268.creator: Yukari Ono, Arika Ida, Takashi Ogimi, Masahiro Asari, Koji Numata, Yo Mikayama, Manabu Shiozawa
pmc-10600268.description: A 72-year-old man with type 2 sub-circumferential tumors in the descending colon and two nodules around the pedicle of the inferior mesenteric artery (main lymph node area) underwent laparoscopic left hemicolectomy with D3 lymphadenectomy. Two lymph nodes around the inferior mesenteric artery pedicle were completely excised. Pathological examination revealed a moderately differentiated tubular adenocarcinoma.

pmc-11610259.title: Oral vancomycin use and incidence of vancomycin-resistant enterococci: time-series analysis
pmc-11610259.creator: Seongman Bae, Kyungkeun Cho, Inah Park, Jiae Kim, Hyewon Han, Jiwon Jung, Sung-Han Kim, Sang-Oh Lee
pmc-11610259.description: BackgroundVancomycin exposure is a major risk factor for vancomycin-resistant enterococci (VRE) colonisation, but the relationship between oral vancomycin and the risk of VRE colonisation remains poorly understood without ecological evidence. In this study, we investigated the association between oral vancomycin usage and the incidence of hospital-acquired VRE using a time-series analysis.

pmc-11664542.title: Clinical evaluation of bispectral index‐guided closed‐loop infusion of propofol for preschool children: A multi‐center randomized controlled study
pmc-11664542.creator: Lei Hua, Bin Du, Yunxia Zuo, Huacheng Liu, Jianmin Zhang
pmc-11664542.description: ImportanceThe closed‐loop infusion system can automatically adjust and maintain the depth of anesthesia by using the propofol target‐controlled infusion (TCI) model under the feedback guidance of the bispectral index (BIS).ObjectiveTo evaluate the safety and superiority of closed‐loop TCI of propofol guided by BIS during maintenance of generalized intravenous anesthesia for preschool children.

pmc-13226021.title: Advances in chemoprevention of familial adenomatous polyposis
pmc-13226021.creator: Ruicheng Li, Rong Cao, Jiaqi Kang, Yuwei Li, Xin Lin, Zhao Zhang
pmc-13226021.description: Familial adenomatous polyposis (FAP) is an autosomal dominant hereditary disease characterized by the early onset of numerous intestinal polyps, which, if untreated, may progress to colon cancer. Traditional treatments have primarily relied on surgical resection; however, with advancements in molecular biology and pharmacology, chemoprevention has increasingly become an important adjunct in the treatment of FAP.

pmc-13254240.title: How Does Artificial Intelligence Align With Person‐Centred Principles in Mental Health Nursing? A Scoping Review
pmc-13254240.creator: Carmel Bond, Adrianna Lorraine Watson, Graeme D Smith, Helen Aveyard, Debra Jackson
pmc-13254240.description: Artificial intelligence is increasingly used in mental health nursing, yet its alignment with person‐centred care remains underexplored. This scoping review examines the extent to which artificial intelligence applications in mental health nursing align with person‐centred principles, and where tensions and risk emerge. A systematic search of three electronic databases identified studies published since 2018.

pmc-13259126.title: Enhancing Biodegradability of Poly(L-Lactic Acid) via Incorporation of Thermoplastic Chitosan
pmc-13259126.creator: Yodthong Baimark, Prasong Srihanam, Yaowalak Srisuwan
pmc-13259126.description: Poly(L-lactic acid) (PLLA) is a biodegradable polyester that has garnered widespread attention for its potential applications as a replacement for conventional petroleum-based plastics. However, PLLA’s prolonged biodegradation is a significant limitation in its applications, particularly in single-use packaging, as it can lead to environmental accumulation and hinder the sustainability goals of reducing plastic waste.

pmc-13462023.title: A preliminary cross-sectional study of bipolarity and primary pharmacotherapy in long-term stable patients with major depressive disorder
pmc-13462023.creator: Taku Maruki, Takashi Tsuboi, Hitoshi Maeshima, Yasuyuki Matsumoto, Teruo Tada, Koichiro Watanabe
pmc-13462023.description: BackgroundPatients with major depressive disorder (MDD) who exhibit high bipolarity are at increased risk of future diagnostic conversion to bipolar disorder. However, treatment recommendations for MDD with bipolarity are constrained by limited direct evidence. We examined the association between bipolarity and primary pharmacotherapy in long-term stable outpatients with MDD and explored a clinically useful Bipolarity Index (BI) threshold.
